data.title: 五河琴里 · 暖桌旁水手服白发带的稚气熟睡
data.description: 初春微凉的午后五河家客厅，琴里戴着纯白软妹发带，穿着来禅中学水手服钻在暖桌里，怀里抱着巨型玩偶甜甜入睡，嘴角带着晶莹微笑。
data.action: 下半身钻入日式暖桌，上半身趴在桌面软垫上，怀抱毛绒小熊闭目熟睡，白发带轻软垂落
data.lighting: 阳光穿透阳台白纱，在客厅地板与暖桌被子上织出柔和光晕
data.camera: 俯拍特写，捕捉纯真妹妹模式毫无心防的恬静面容
data.promptProse: Kotori Itsuka slumbers peacefully on a chilly afternoon, snug from the waist down inside a warm wooden kotatsu in the family living room. Wearing her white Raizen Junior High sailor uniform adorned with innocent white ribbons, she slumps forward on the padded tabletop, clutching a giant stuffed bear to her chest. Sunlight through sheer curtains highlights her soft, untroubled sleeping expression.
data.animaCaption: Tucked comfortably into the warm kotatsu, Kotori hugs her stuffed bear and dozes off with an innocent, peaceful expression.
